title: Look Lab
description: One small-town street blockout in twelve looks: seasons, night, wardrobe, a different person, anime, claymation, 3D animated and watercolour, all sharing one camera and one blocking.

environment.description: A quiet small-town main street on a sunny summer afternoon: painted shopfronts, a leafy maple and hills beyond
environment.style: Photoreal, warm afternoon sun, soft shadows, natural colour. No logos, brand names, badges, signage or lettering anywhere

entities.name: Hills
entities.notes: Rolling green hills beyond the town

entities.name: Road north
entities.notes: A two-lane asphalt street with a faded centre line

entities.name: Sidewalk east north
entities.notes: Pale concrete sidewalks with a low kerb

entities.name: Verge east north

entities.name: East shop 1

entities.notes: A plain wooden park bench on cast-iron legs

entities.name: Parked car

entities.name: Walker
entities.notes: Adult in their thirties, shoulder-length brown hair, light blue cotton shirt, beige chinos, white canvas shoes
